notes.title: Support for controllers and remote play together.
notes.content:
Added support for controllers, and remote play together - Windows only!
User running the game can still accept connections of cellphones and controllers. Remote players can join using controllers only!  On remote controllers vibration will not work - only for local players.

tags.feature: - Added support for controllers, and remote play together - Windows only!

notes.title: Added controller support and remote play together
notes.content:
Added controller support and remote play together. (Windows version only).
Player running the game can still connect with cellphones and controllers while remote players can connect using controllers.  Controller vibration will work only for local players not for remote.
